detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Experience the Vampire Survivors soundscape with the Vampire Survivors Soundtrack

Composed by Daniele Zandara, Filippo Vicarelli, & Will Davies

Containing 71 tracks from both the main game and various DLC's, listen to your Hollow Heart's content while out of game, out of the house, or simply outrunning Red Death. There's even a kazoo!

All tracks are both MP3 (320Kbit/s at 44.1khz) & FLAC lossless files (48khz)

Please note, this OST does not include tracks from Vampire Survivors: Operation Guns or Vampire Survivors: Ode to Castlevania or Vampire Survivors: Emerald Diorama

Features:

🎶48 tracks from Vampire Survivors, including Treasure Chest opening jingles, across 3 disks

🎶6 tracks from Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Moonspell DLC

🎶11 tracks from Vampire Survivors: Tides of the Foscari DLC

🎶6 tracks from Vampire Survivors: Emergency Meeting
